documents.content: When sender and receiver identify identical content by the same cryptographic content hash, a warm receiver cache can avoid retransmitting the already present content bytes.
Lossless compression reduces payload bytes only when the encoded representation plus required framing is smaller than the original representation.
Content deduplication alone does not prove lower end-to-end latency for every workload because hashing, cache lookup, compression CPU cost, congestion and round-trip time also affect latency.
